page.description: Bliss OS editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: An Android build for x86 PCs: Android 12 with the Play Store in the GApps image, keyboard and mouse support, and a desktop-style launcher instead of a phone UI.
pros: Runs Android apps and games on ordinary x86_64 PCs and laptops.
Play Store included in the GApps image, so apps install normally.
Boots from a USB stick or installs to disk alongside another system.
Kernel tuned for desktop hardware, with Wi-Fi, sound and touchpad support.
cons: Android on PC is a compatibility project: not every app or device works.
The publisher lists MD5 only, so the SHA-256 here was computed by ROMinit.
Safety-net and Play Integrity checks fail on most hardware.
The 16.x line is from 2024; the project's newer builds sit in a separate repository.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for Bliss OS; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: Write the ISO to a USB stick with dd or any image writer; writing erases the stick. The installer then creates a partition or installs into an existing one.
